scope: Independent generic sub-04 confirmation, the original fit/test of 512 had already been examined: 17/18 distinct contrasting pairs, failed >=20 pairs. Attribute measurements and scores of these additional objects were unavailable at registration. Their EEG was previously used by unrelated word classifiers. Fixed model parameters, label algorithm, analytical controls and directional operating rule. No candidate model search.
subject: sub-04
attribute: Clean neutral light background versus a visibly varied textured background; intermediate and inadequate masks uncertain. Full original measurement and EEG probability readouts unchanged.
inference: All 512 objects and all 5120 original photos of the additional calibration acquisition. Exactly the previously trained 320-object EEG ridge head, the two scales calibrated on 96 original objects, sub-04 four physical observations, fixed adjacent pairs and other eight support annotations/EEG per object. Two photos per pair are independently inferred and never used as support for each other. Signed exchanged-EEG donor is the other held photo; uncertainty labels enter support prior as .5.
endpoints: Identical three Brier differences on confidently annotated photos (each positive 95% lower bound): matched better than class eight-support, same-fold exchanged EEG, and color/luminance-only EEG. For disjoint contrasting pairs require at least 20 pairs and lower CI above .5. The original report showed only the textured direction can currently support prompt use. Require >=20 confidently labelled texture interventions with measured textured-label precision >=.70 and also a strictly positive paired point Brier improvement against exchanged EEG among true textured photos; report light and texture individually, unknown actions, false positives and the identical counterfactual light rule. Same all-objects cluster bootstrap (10000,seed 260701); ratios pool queried photographs. No retraining, gain estimation, threshold change, selected subset or threshold failures removed.
image_plan: Only if all endpoints pass. Use the existing sub-04 learned fresh_mix direction and decoded word for all 480 registered trials across the four menus (including incorrect predicted words), frozen H14, radius, 4 steps, same batch 8, row seed 923761+original row, no target image or true word accessed by inference. Only the one-sided textured phrase is eligible: matched is on when p<=.25 and p-prior<=-.10; otherwise preserve original. Wrong EEG uses the frozen same-predicted-word/same-fold rotation from the visual packet, evaluated against recipient supports (singleton remains self, report strict nonself separately). Rate-matched prior-only ranks all rows within each menu by ascending eight-support probability, using SHA256("260701/menu/row") as deterministic tie-break; assign as many suffixes as the matched method in that menu. This batch-level control shares only the matched arm action count, not its locations. Base arm always keeps the original prompt. For all active arms append literal " with a visibly varied, textured background" before the final period. Use existing original JPEG parity and frozen original independent clip/DINO/protocol, plus remeasure generated background against reference. Preparation outputs only predicted words, supports, own vectors, row seeds, scores and prompt flags, without true photos or labels. Eligible target support annotations can be cached; every active fold may access only its selected eight support IDs.
